import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = scanner.nextLong();
        long y = scanner.nextLong();
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        double min_ = 1e30;
        long ans_a = 0, ans_b = 0;
        long i = 1;
        while (i <= n) {
            long a = x * i / y;
            double diff = Math.abs((double)x / y - (double)a / i);
            if (diff < min_) {
                min_ = diff;
                ans_a = a;
                ans_b = i;
            }
            a++;
            diff = Math.abs((double)x / y - (double)a / i);
            if (diff < min_) {
                min_ = diff;
                ans_a = a;
                ans_b = i;
            }
            ++i;
        }
        System.out.println(ans_a + "/" + ans_b);
    }
}
